description: Focus and break cycles, with the key lit while the time runs
author: Deck example
permission.1: Plays a Windows sound when the time is up
setting.focus.label: Focus minutes
setting.pause.label: Break minutes
setting.sound.label: Play a sound when the time is up
step.1: Turn on the plugin and set the focus and break minutes.
step.2: Drag the **Start or pause** action onto a key. It stays lit while the time runs.
step.3: When focus ends, the break starts on its own (and vice versa). The status up here shows how much is left.
action.toggle.label: Start or pause
action.toggle.help: Starts focus, pauses or resumes. The key stays lit while the time runs.
action.reset.label: Reset the Pomodoro
action.reset.help: Stops and goes back to the start of focus.
